title: Hurshimchung Spa
description: Named as Oncheonjang Inn, this district has a long history. A story related to Dongnae Hot Springs tells that during the Silla period, there lived a limping old lady, who found a crane that also limped like her. One day, she saw it flying up strongly in the sky. When approaching where the crane had been, she found a hot spring. After getting soaked in hot water, her aching leg was fully recovered.In fact, Dongnae Hot Springs is rich in minerals that help alleviate pain from arthritis and neuralgia. . Dongnae Hot Springs, which is said to have an excellent healing effect on adult diseases, is well-known as the largest hot spring facility in the East. It boasts grandeur and magnificence that even motivated a bath-themed cartoon. Natural light from the glass ceiling creates a brighter and warmer atmosphere. More than 10 types of baths are available, along with diverse amenities.How would you feel if you see oceanic views leisurely while looking up at the sky overhead in magnificent hot springs in Busan? Does it feel like you’re a nobleman? Come to Busan to take a hot spring tour, relieve your fatigue, and experience the healing power.

Get To Know a New Dimension of Sport at Busan E-Sports Arena!
description: Busan E-sports Arena (BRENA) is an e-sports stadium in Seomyeon where everyone can watch and experience e-sports. It hosts various games, from major e-sports competitions to amateur leagues, and also has a training and research room for professional players, making it a great place for anyone who loves e-sports to visit.

title: 체험하며 만나는 진짜 부산 바다, 공수어촌체험휴양마을
Experience the Real Busan Sea at Gongsu Fishing Village
description: Gongsu Fishing Village (Gongsu Village) is a tranquil fishing village nestled along the coastline at the far edge of Gijang in Busan. The village offers breathtaking views of the East Sea, where vast open waters crash against dramatic rocky formations. But there’s more that makes Gongsu Village truly special.Designated as a model fishing village for experiential tourism in 2001, Gongsu Fishing Village offers a variety of hands-on programs that let you do more than simply admire the sea — here, you can experience the spirit of Busan’s ocean with all your senses.

title: Busan O’Kitchen Cooking House
description: In Centum City, Haeundae—Busan’s vibrant hub of shopping, exhibitions, and culture—Ottogi has opened the Busan O’Kitchen Cooking House, a space for hands-on culinary experience. Following its first studio in Gangnam, Seoul, this is the company’s second venue offering interactive cooking programs.

Sabai Sabai in Jeonpo – A Space that Inspires Everyday Life
description: Sabai Sabai in Jeonpo is more than a shop. It captures the spirit of Busan with its blend of products, culture, creative workshops, exhibitions, and local content. Beyond browsing, it’s a place to spark inspiration and create lasting memories.

description: Where Gwangalli’s lights meet Haeundae’s waves, Breakout is more than just an escape room.Step into the story as the main character, uncover the mystery, chase the hidden truth, and experience a cinematic adventure like no other.

description: Busan is blessed with natural resources composed of the sea, mountains, and the river. Recently, the Nakdong River Eco Tour Cruise is becoming a popular attraction of Busan.

title: Discover nature’s wonder through paddleboarding
description: With a similar atmosphere to California where marine leisure and sports activities are concerned, Busan is nicknamed “Busanfornia.” It has characteristic beaches to allow beachgoers to enjoy diverse types of leisure and sports activities throughout the year, and the seafront is easily accessed from downtown Busan.

title: 바다와 음악, 버스커와 관객이 만드는 최고의 무대
The night, music, and the best performances by buskers and the audience
description: Nothing compares with the addition of music to the romantic night sea. Busking, meaning “street performance,” is now a familiar culture often found in Busan’s Haeundae Beach and Gwangalli Beach, as well as Seomyeon and Nampo-dong, which are Busan’s downtowns. Busking in Busan has the unique charm of the beautiful night sea view in its background, which is both pleasing to the eyes and ears.

title: 미래를 비추는 거울, 아이들의 공간 키자니아
KidZania, a space for children who are the mirror of the future
description: “What do kids know?”This is what adults often say, but it is different when it comes to this space.Here, they can do anything and become anyone.KidZania is Busan’s unique place that gives kids special memories in their lives and allows them to do role-play activities.

title: 맨발로 걷기 좋은 황토숲길, 회동수원지를 거닐다
Walk around Hoedong Reservoir, a place that embraces eternal nature
description: The Hoedong Reservoir is a large area that combines rivers, lakes, and forests. It has long been untouched by people and, thus, expresses an intact nature. Its two trails, Ttangmoesan Mountain Red Clay Forest Trail and Galmaetgil Trail, and its hinoki cypress forest are famous “healing spots” beloved by many city dwellers who love to walk in the woods.

title: Busan Aquarium, where you can see, smell, hear, and feel the sea
description: Haeundae Beach first comes to mind when people think about Busan.However, if you find the sun-drenched and hot white sand a bit burdensome, or if you prefer a cool breeze of an air-conditioner indoors,you can visit Busan Aquarium in Haeundae Beach, where you will surely enjoy your holiday. Sea Life Busan Aquarium introduces you to the incredible world of more than 10,000 marine creatures with over 250 species.It presents a spectacular sight consisting of 8 theme zones, an 80m long submarine tunnel, and 2 main aquariums.

title: Feel alive with mountain biking!
description: Mountain biking entails riding bicycles on off-road trails, such as rough hills and mountains. It makes you feel “alive,” an experience unachievable from other activities. Pedaling up a mountain can be harder than any other sport, but you will feel extremely thrilled as you fly down the mountain biking trail, enjoying the cool breeze.

title: 빳빳한 도복 자락에 담긴 한국의 정신, 태권도
Taekwondo—the spirit of Korea in its stiff uniform called dobok
description: Taekwondo is one of Korea’s traditional martial arts. Since adopted as an official Olympic sport for the 2000 Olympic Games in Sydney, Australia, it has been recognized as a global martial art that is enjoyed and practiced by people around the world, with Taekwondo associations being operated in over 200 countries. Aside from being a martial art, it is also a cultural activity that anyone can experience for leisure or sports.

title: 일상 속 쉼표를 찍는 시간, 템플스테이
Templestay, a time to take a break from your daily life
description: What modern people dream of and long for is to take a rest, to escape from the hustle and bustle of daily life that repeats itself like a wheel. If you can

title: Busan Local Food Cooking Class
description: This is a Busan-based local food tour.Feel free to enjoy the taste of Busan by cooking with Busan’s local specialties and freshly caught seafood available at Jagalchi Market.Busan Local Food Cooking Class will be composed of the following stages.Duration: 3.5–4 hr[1] Enjoying a lecture on Korean cuisine and Busan food culture with a cup of tea to welcome participants[2] Cooking experience[3] Paring food with a traditional local wine [4] Practicing the local tea ceremony[5] Taking a tour around the traditional market and getting shopping assistance

title: Enjoy a picnic on the weekend at the farm.
description: What should I do this weekend? I’m going to visit the experience farm with a unique natural landscape.The Durufarm offers the highest satisfaction with a chance to pick and experience blueberries in the summer, strawberries in the spring and winter, and sweet potatoes and peanuts in the fall. Eat all you want, pick the fruits, make tasty dishes, and take some home. Visit the prosperous fields of Seobusan Mountain for a highly satisfying experience.

title: Enjoy Kayaking Down The River
description: Every summer, you think about how you will beat the heat. You can’t just stay indoors with the air conditioning on all the time, but you can’t spend a fortune either, especially now that you have to plan your life with social distancing in mind. Although there aren’t many options, there is one way to get out and enjoy the cool river breeze. Kayaking, how does that sound?

title: Busan X the Sky Observatory
